rv.q: As transmitted in this fine production, it still sends a shiver down the spine.
Otherwise, shivers, not to mention other vital responses, are in short supply in Robin Lefevre's flaccid revival, which the Roundabout Theatre Company opened last night.
The politics is subtle, the story is arch, the acting sublime.

tn.cat: Best Costume Design of a Play

cn.t: Shaw's WWI-era dissection of the bourgeoisie earns praise for sublime acting and artful direction, though some question whether the play's grandeur fully resonates. Most critics find it a delightful, politically astute production.
